build-server.py.source:
"""Build an ordinary server from an exact index tree; retain source and compiler provenance."""
import hashlib, io, json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tarfile, time

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'write-tree'], text=True).strip()
source = root / 'source'
assert not source.exists()
source.mkdir()
archive = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'archive', tree, 'BasisRustServer'])
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar:
    tar.extractall(source, filter='data')
target = root / 'build-release'
assert not target.exists()
# Copy the ordinary dependency cache; never overwrite older frozen binaries.
shutil.copytree(repo / 'captures/scene-receipt-investigation-20261010/build-release', target)
environment = dict(os.environ, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(target), CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0', CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2',
                   RUSTFLAGS='-Cllvm-args=-pgo-warn-missing-function')
environment.pop('CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', None)
command = ['cargo', '+1.99.0', 'build', '--locked', '--release', '--target',
           'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu', '-p', 'basis-server-console']
manifest = {'parent_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
            'source_index_tree': tree,
            'server_source_tree': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', f'{tree}:BasisRustServer'], text=True).strip(),
            'compiler': subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '+1.99.0', '-vV'], text=True),
            'command': command, 'cwd': str(source / 'BasisRustServer'),
            'environment': {key: environment[key] for key in ['CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'CARGO_INCREMENTAL', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'RUSTFLAGS']},
            'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS': 'unset', 'pgo': False,
            'source_files': {str(path.relative_to(source)): sha(path) for path in sorted(source.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()},
            'started_unix_seconds': time.time()}
with (root / 'build-controller.log').open('w') as log:
    process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=source / 'BasisRustServer', env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
manifest['exit_code'] = process.returncode
manifest['finished_unix_seconds'] = time.time()
binary = target / 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/basis-server-console'
if process.returncode == 0:
    manifest['binary'] = str(binary)
    manifest['binary_sha256'] = sha(binary)
(root / 'build-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
assert process.returncode == 0, 'Server build failed'
print('Built ordinary frozen server:' + manifest['binary_sha256'], flush=True)

compare-batching.py.source:
"""One ordinary binary, batching 2/3 ms; strict failures remain explicit."""
import argparse, importlib.util, json, os, pathlib, shutil, socket, subprocess, sys

repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / 'scripts/perf'))
from avatar_benchmark import relevant_env, run_workload, select_port, workload_metadata, write_json
from avatar_tuning import run_order, sha256, summarize
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('compare', repo / 'scripts/perf/compare-avatar-revisions.py')
compare = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(compare)
settings = compare.settings
p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--server', type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--output', type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--batch-ms', type=int, choices=[3], default=3)
p.add_argument('--repeats', type=int, default=2)
p.add_argument('--clients', type=int, default=750)
p.add_argument('--scene-interval-ms', type=int, default=50)
supplied = p.parse_args()
prior = json.loads((repo / 'captures/pgo-mixed-client750-20261010/setup.json').read_text())
args = settings.parser().parse_args([
    '--server', str(supplied.server), '--client', prior['binaries']['client'],
    '--output', str(supplied.output), '--clients', str(supplied.clients),
    '--warmup-seconds', '45', '--window-seconds', '60', '--repeats', str(supplied.repeats),
    '--server-cpus', '2-9', '--client-cpus', '10-15', '--rayon-threads', '4',
    '--tokio-workers', '4', '--client-workers', '4', '--additional-avatar-bytes', '128',
    '--scene-data-bytes', '128', '--scene-data-interval-ms', str(supplied.scene_interval_ms)])
settings.validate(args)
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {0, 1})
args.port = select_port(socket.SOCK_DGRAM, 0)
args.health_port = select_port(socket.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
args.output.mkdir()
artifacts = {}
for key in ('server', 'client', 'server_config', 'client_config'):
    source = getattr(args, key).resolve()
    destination = args.output / 'frozen' / key / source.name
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(source, destination)
    artifacts[key] = {'path': str(destination), 'sha256': sha256(destination), 'original_path': str(source)}
    setattr(args, key, destination)
env, cleared = settings.clean_environment(args.server_config, args.client_config)
server_env = dict(env, BASIS_AVATAR_FLUSH_LANES='0', RAYON_NUM_THREADS='4', TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS='4')
client_env = dict(env, BASIS_CLIENT_TOKIO_WORKERS='4', BASIS_AVATAR_DIAGNOSTICS='true')
tool_paths = [pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve(), pathlib.Path(compare.__file__), pathlib.Path(settings.__file__),
              repo / 'scripts/perf/avatar_benchmark.py', repo / 'scripts/perf/avatar_tuning.py']
tools = {str(path): sha256(path) for path in tool_paths}
def power():
    return {'profile': subprocess.check_output(['powerprofilesctl', 'get'], text=True).strip(),
            'AC_online': pathlib.Path('/sys/class/power_supply/ADP0/online').read_text().strip()}
experiment = {'comparison_kind': 'revisions', 'comparison_dimension': 'BASIS_SCENE_BATCH_MS',
    'same_binary': True, 'baseline_batch_ms': 2, 'candidate_batch_ms': 3, 'pgo': False, 'os_name': os.name, 'repeats': supplied.repeats,
    'coordinator_affinity': sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)), 'frozen': artifacts,
    'tool_sha256': tools, 'cleared_environment_keys': cleared, 'workload': workload_metadata(args),
    'invocation': [sys.executable, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()), *sys.argv[1:]],
    'power_before': power(), 'runs': [],
    'invalid_continuation_policy': 'Retain strict delivery/error/shutdown failures. Continue only completed runs with continuous full-population readiness, fixed provenance and frozen artifacts. No gate is relaxed.'}
assert experiment['power_before'] == {'profile': 'performance', 'AC_online': '1'}
runs = []
def save():
    write_json(args.output / 'experiment.json', experiment)
    write_json(args.output / 'summary.json', {'experiment': experiment, 'runs': runs,
                                             'comparison': compare.aggregate(runs, supplied.repeats)})
save()
with settings.experiment_lock():
    try:
        for i, (round_index, variant) in enumerate(run_order(['baseline', 'candidate'], supplied.repeats)):
            selected_env = dict(server_env, BASIS_SCENE_BATCH_MS='2' if variant == 'baseline' else str(supplied.batch_ms))
            entry = {'name': f'{i+1:02d}-{variant}', 'round': round_index, 'variant': variant,
                     'server_settings': relevant_env(selected_env), 'client_settings': relevant_env(client_env)}
            for artifact in artifacts.values():
                assert sha256(pathlib.Path(artifact['path'])) == artifact['sha256']
            for path, expected in tools.items():
                assert sha256(pathlib.Path(path)) == expected
            assert power() == experiment['power_before']
            experiment['runs'].append(entry)
            save()
            print('START ' + entry['name'], flush=True)
            directory = args.output / entry['name']
            run_workload(args, directory, selected_env, client_env)
            result = summarize(directory, experiment, entry)
            runs.append(result)
            write_json(directory / 'validated-summary.json', result)
            save()
            metrics = result['metrics']
            failed = [k for k, value in result['checks'].items() if not value]
            print(f'END {entry["name"]}: scene={metrics["scene_observer_delivery_ratio"]:.4%}, scene-p95<={metrics["scene_latency_p95_upper_ms"]:.2f}ms, avatar-p95={metrics["gap_p95_ms"]:.2f}ms, CPU={metrics["server_cpu_cores"]:.2f}; failed={failed}', flush=True)
            required = ['completed', 'continuous_readiness', 'coverage', 'fixed_workload_provenance',
                        'control_provenance', 'mixed_command_provenance', 'frozen_server', 'frozen_client']
            assert all(result['checks'][key] for key in required), 'Essential experiment integrity failed'
            samples = [json.loads(line) for line in (directory / 'samples.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
            assert all(s['players_online'] == s['active_states'] == args.clients for s in samples)
    except BaseException as error:
        experiment['error'] = f'{type(error).__name__}: {error}'
        save()
        raise
    finally:
        experiment['power_after'] = power()
        save()
print('COMPLETE; every strict failure retained.', flush=True)

retain-evidence.py.source:
"""Rederive each 2/3-ms trial; preserve failed gates and raw measured outcomes."""
import importlib.util, json, pathlib, sys

repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / 'scripts/perf'))
from avatar_tuning import sha256, summarize, run_order
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('compare', repo / 'scripts/perf/compare-avatar-revisions.py')
compare = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(compare)

def capture(directory):
    samples = [json.loads(line) for line in (directory / 'samples.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    for sample in samples:
        health = sample['health']
        sample['health'] = {'extended': {key: health['extended'][key] for key in
                                       ['appMessages', 'avatarSync', 'rawUdp', 'reliable']},
                            'transport': health['transport']}
    return {'process_samples': samples,
            'run_metadata': json.loads((directory / 'run.json').read_text()),
            'commands': json.loads((directory / 'commands.json').read_text()),
            'ready_health': json.loads((directory / 'ready-health.json').read_text()),
            'csv': {name: (directory / name).read_text() for name in
                    ['observer.csv', 'observer.sender.csv', 'server-pairs.global.csv', 'scene.csv']},
            'scene_relay_log': [line for line in (directory / 'server.log').read_text().splitlines()
                                if 'scene relay' in line or 'scene batching' in line or 'SceneBatch:' in line],
            'artifact_sha256': {file.name: sha256(file) for file in directory.iterdir() if file.is_file()}}

def retain(directory):
    saved = json.loads((directory / 'summary.json').read_text())
    experiment = saved['experiment']
    assert [(run['round'], run['variant']) for run in saved['runs']] == run_order(
        ['baseline', 'candidate'], experiment['repeats'])
    assert experiment['baseline_batch_ms'] == 2 and experiment['candidate_batch_ms'] == 3
    assert experiment['power_before'] == experiment['power_after'] == {'profile': 'performance', 'AC_online': '1'}
    saved['raw_runs'] = {}
    for entry, result in zip(experiment['runs'], saved['runs']):
        path = directory / entry['name']
        assert summarize(path, experiment, entry) == result
        assert entry['server_settings']['BASIS_SCENE_BATCH_MS'] == ('2' if entry['variant'] == 'baseline' else '3')
        evidence = capture(path)
        assert all(sample['players_online'] == sample['active_states'] == 750 for sample in evidence['process_samples'])
        saved['raw_runs'][entry['name']] = evidence
        result['failed_checks'] = [key for key, value in result['checks'].items() if not value]
        retx = [sample['health']['extended']['reliable']['retransmits'] for sample in evidence['process_samples']]
        result['retransmits_observed'] = {'first': retx[0], 'last': retx[-1], 'delta': retx[-1] - retx[0],
                                         'minimum': min(retx), 'maximum': max(retx)}
    for artifact in experiment['frozen'].values():
        assert sha256(pathlib.Path(artifact['path'])) == artifact['sha256']
    for path, expected in experiment['tool_sha256'].items():
        assert sha256(pathlib.Path(path)) == expected
    saved['comparison'] = compare.aggregate(saved['runs'], experiment['repeats'])
    return saved

reference = repo / 'docs/performance/results/csharp-mixed-client750-20261010-summary.json'
csharp = json.loads(reference.read_text())
output = {'cohorts': {directory.name: retain(directory) for directory in sorted(root.glob('evaluation*'))
                      if directory.is_dir() and (directory / 'summary.json').exists()},
          'build': json.loads((root / 'build-manifest.json').read_text()),
          'csharp_reference': {'path': str(reference.relative_to(repo)), 'sha256': sha256(reference),
              'setup': csharp['setup'], 'cohorts': {name: {'experiment': csharp['cohorts'][name]['experiment'],
                                                         'runs': csharp['cohorts'][name]['runs']}
                                                  for name in ['evaluation-20hz', 'evaluation-5hz']}},
          'local_controllers': {name: {'source': (root / name).read_text(), 'sha256': sha256(root / name)}
                                for name in ['build-server.py', 'compare-batching.py', 'retain-evidence.py', 'write-report.py', 'verify-final.py']},
          'checks': {file.name: {'log': file.read_text(), 'sha256': sha256(file)}
                     for file in root.glob('check-*.log')},
          'review': {'log': (root / 'review.ndjson').read_text(), 'sha256': sha256(root / 'review.ndjson')},
          'controller_logs': {file.name: {'log': file.read_text(), 'sha256': sha256(file)}
                              for file in root.glob('*controller.log')},
          'limits': ['One Linux laptop, loopback, one receiver observer, CPU-only server, voice/P2P off.',
                     'Two fresh processes per interval/rate in ABBA order; medians are descriptive.',
                     'Both Rust arms use one newly built ordinary binary; PGO is off for changed source.',
                     'C# reference results are earlier separate processes, not interleaved cross-server A/B.',
                     'Rust collector interval and C# per-peer transport merge hold are different stages.',
                     'Strict delivery/error flags remain unchanged; no dropped work is accepted as a speedup.',
                     'Scene latency percentiles are received-message histogram upper bounds; receive grace is in scene denominator.',
                     '1000Mbps is a reporting reference, not a traffic shaper.',
                     'Existing batched scene app-output accounting limitation remains experimental.']}
destination = repo / 'docs/performance/results/scene-batch3-client750-20261010-summary.json'
destination.write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
print(f'Retained {destination} ({destination.stat().st_size:,} bytes)')

write-report.py.source:
"""Report same-binary interval A/B and a separately measured C# reference."""
import json, pathlib, statistics

repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
evidence = repo / 'docs/performance/results/scene-batch3-client750-20261010-summary.json'
d = json.loads(evidence.read_text())
def median(runs, key):
    return statistics.median(r['metrics'][key] for r in runs)
def groups(name):
    runs = d['cohorts'][name]['runs']
    return [('Rust 2 ms', [r for r in runs if r['variant'] == 'baseline']),
            ('Rust 3 ms', [r for r in runs if r['variant'] == 'candidate']),
            ('C# 3-ms hold', d['csharp_reference']['cohorts'][name]['runs'])]
def table(name):
    lines = ['| Server / interval | Scene receipt | Scene p95 bound | Avatar p95 gap | Applied avatar items/s | Server CPU cores | Gates passed |',
             '| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |']
    for label, runs in groups(name):
        lines.append(f'| {label} | {median(runs,"scene_observer_delivery_ratio"):.3%} | '
                     f'{median(runs,"scene_latency_p95_upper_ms"):,.3f} ms | '
                     f'{median(runs,"gap_p95_ms"):,.3f} ms | '
                     f'{median(runs,"observer_applied_items_per_second"):,.3f} | '
                     f'{median(runs,"server_cpu_cores"):.3f} | {sum(r["valid"] for r in runs)}/{len(runs)} |')
    return '\n'.join(lines)
for name, cohort in d['cohorts'].items():
    assert len(cohort['runs']) == 4
two20, three20 = groups('evaluation-20hz')[0][1], groups('evaluation-20hz')[1][1]
two5, three5 = groups('evaluation-5hz')[0][1], groups('evaluation-5hz')[1][1]
report = ['# Rust 3-ms scene batching: 750-client interval A/B — 2026-10-10', '',
    '`BASIS_SCENE_BATCH_MS=3` is now supported, matching the numeric default of the C# reference’s '
    '`MergeHoldMs=3`. Unset/0 still disables the experimental relay; 1 and 2 ms remain supported. '
    'This change only extends accepted configuration and tests. The collector, queue bounds, recipient '
    'lanes, transport format and eligible traffic are unchanged.', '',
    f'At 20 Hz, median scene receipt is {median(two20,"scene_observer_delivery_ratio"):.3%} with 2 ms '
    f'and {median(three20,"scene_observer_delivery_ratio"):.3%} with 3 ms. Both remain below the '
    'original 95% target; this does not establish a capacity improvement. At 5 Hz, '
    f'3-ms receipt is {median(three5,"scene_observer_delivery_ratio"):.3%}, with '
    f'{sum(r["valid"] for r in three5)}/2 processes passing every original gate. '
    'The reduced scene rate is a freshness tradeoff, not success at the original 20-Hz rate.', '',
    '## Matched measurements', '',
    'Each rate uses four fresh server/client process pairs in **2/3/3/2-ms ABBA order**, two per '
    'interval, with one newly built ordinary Rust server binary. The single A/B dimension is '
    '`BASIS_SCENE_BATCH_MS=2/3`. All original receipt, cadence, population, error, retransmit and '
    'shutdown checks remain enforced. Failed overload runs retain their invalid flags.', '',
    '### Original 20-Hz scene workload', '', table('evaluation-20hz'), '',
    '### Separate 5-Hz scene workload', '', table('evaluation-5hz'), '',

verify-final.py.source:
"""Attest final source, available controls and each original measurement gate."""
import json, pathlib, subprocess

repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
d = json.loads((repo / 'docs/performance/results/scene-batch3-client750-20261010-summary.json').read_text())
tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'write-tree'], text=True).strip()
assert d['build']['server_source_tree'] == subprocess.check_output(
    ['git', 'rev-parse', f'{tree}:BasisRustServer'], text=True).strip()
count = 0
for name, cohort in d['cohorts'].items():
    assert len(cohort['runs']) == 4
    work = cohort['experiment']['workload']
    ref = d['csharp_reference']['cohorts'][name]['experiment']
    for key in ('clients', 'warmup_seconds', 'window_seconds', 'rayon_threads', 'tokio_workers',
                'client_workers', 'server_cpus', 'client_cpus', 'additional_avatar_bytes',
                'scene_data_bytes', 'scene_data_interval_ms', 'scene_data_reliable', 'network_capacity_mbps'):
        assert work[key] == ref['workload'][key], key
    assert cohort['experiment']['frozen']['server']['sha256'] == d['build']['binary_sha256']
    for key in ('client', 'client_config', 'server_config'):
        assert cohort['experiment']['frozen'][key]['sha256'] == ref['frozen'][key]['sha256'], key
    envs = [entry['server_settings'] for entry in cohort['experiment']['runs']]
    common = [{key: value for key, value in env.items() if key != 'BASIS_SCENE_BATCH_MS'} for env in envs]
    assert all(env == common[0] for env in common)
    for result in cohort['runs']:
        assert all(result['checks'][key] for key in ('completed', 'continuous_readiness', 'coverage',
            'sender_progress', 'sender_errors', 'control_provenance', 'mixed_command_provenance',
            'frozen_server', 'frozen_client', 'counter_window'))
        assert all(result['metrics'][key] == 0 for key in ('scene_send_errors', 'scene_backpressure_skips',
                                                        'scene_malformed_messages', 'scene_duplicate_messages'))
        assert result['scene']['metrics']['observed_senders'] == '749'
        assert result['exits'] == {'client_exit_code': 0, 'server_exit_code': 0}
        samples = cohort['raw_runs'][result['name']]['process_samples']
        count += len(samples)
        assert all(sample['players_online'] == sample['active_states'] == 750 for sample in samples)
        log = (root / name / result['name'] / 'server.log').read_text()
        assert ('scene batching enabled batch_ms=' + ('2' if result['variant'] == 'baseline' else '3')) in log
        assert result['valid'] == (name == 'evaluation-5hz')
review = [json.loads(line) for line in d['review']['log'].splitlines()]
end = next(row for row in reversed(review) if row['type'] == 'complete')
assert end['status'] == 'review_completed' and end['findings'] == 0
message = f'Verified {count} full-population samples across eight matched runs; exact final server source, shared controls/client/fixtures and all strict flags retained\n'
(root / 'check-final-provenance.log').write_text(message)
print(message, end='')
